research.title: Preprocessing and Evaluation for Support Request Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned text normalization and feature extraction routines for classifying support requests using TF-IDF representations and logistic regression.
Ran prescribed evaluation splits, inspected confusion matrices, and documented classification errors involving ambiguous requests and overlapping category definitions.

work.title: Validation Utilities for Text Record Imports
bullets: Maintained Python import routines for text records, adding checks for missing fields, duplicate identifiers, and inconsistent character encoding.
Reproduced reported import failures, updated validation logic, and added regression tests covering malformed records and expected error messages.

projects.title: Bag-of-Words Baselines for Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented multinomial naive Bayes and logistic regression baselines with scikit-learn to classify review sentiment from bag-of-words features.
Compared models on a held-out split using precision, recall, and confusion matrices, then inspected errors associated with negation and mixed sentiment.
